help.text:
usage: ldeep - 0+unknown.ctk [-h] [-o OUTFILE] [--security_desc]
                             {ldap,cache,protections} ...

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -o OUTFILE, --outfile OUTFILE
                        Store the results in a file
  --security_desc       Enable the retrieval of security descriptors in ldeep
                        results

Mode:
  Available modes

  {ldap,cache,protections}
                        Backend engine to retrieve data

--base.help: LDAP base for query (by default, this value is pulled from remote Ldap)

--dir.help: Use saved JSON files in specified directory as cache

--domain.help: The domain as NetBIOS or FQDN

--forest-base.help: LDAP forest base for query (by default, this value is pulled from remote Ldap)

--help.help: show this help message and exit

--kerberos.help: For Kerberos authentication, ticket file should be pointed by $KRB5NAME env variable

--no-encryption.help: Encrypt the communication or not (default: encrypted, except with simple bind and ldap)

--outfile.help: Store the results in a file

--page_size.help: Configure the page size used by the engine to query the LDAP server (default: 1000)

--password.help: The password used for the authentication

--security_desc.help: Enable the retrieval of security descriptors in ldeep results

--throttle.help: Add a throttle between queries to sneak under detection thresholds (in seconds between queries: argument to the sleep function)

--type.help: Authentication type: ntlm (default) or simple. Simple bind will always be in cleartext with ldap (not ldaps)
